Extract chronological events that can be anchored to time.

Return ONLY a JSON array (not an object wrapper, just the raw array):
[
  {
    "date": "YYYY-MM-DD or descriptive time",
    "event": "Brief description of event",
    "chapter_id": "Chapter reference if available",
    "participants": ["Person 1", "Person 2"]
  }
]

Keep it minimal and faithful. Output ONLY the JSON array, nothing else.
